04 / Works with PAGE 04/08
Systems that work with it.
SampleBoot runs each system's own autorun folder, unchanged. Any OS that starts from autorun should work; these are the ones known to work so far, tested on the author's MPC, reported by users, or supported by their own authors. SampleBoot includes none of them: download each one from its author.
System Versions Checked by Notes From
■ Stock firmware 1.3.0 (1.3.0.12) Tested Akai Professional
■ SampQOL OS 0.1.4.7 – 0.4.2 Tested 16 USB outputs: SampleBoot 1.0.1 or later beatops.io/sampqol
■ Melodee 0.1.0 – 0.7.0 Tested Update it by replacing its folder github.com/keremimo/melodee-sample
■ MPC Simple 1.0 Beta 1 – Beta 8 Tested mpcsimple.com
■ MPCTRACKER 0.1.0 Tested Needs an empty sampleboot.inplace file in its folder (SampleBoot 1.0.2 or later) jeffwebb-to/mpc-sample-tracker
■ MPC 600 S v1.7b Tested Needs an empty sampleboot.inplace file in its folder (SampleBoot 1.0.2 or later) LA-2500/MPC-600-S
■ Am MOD r30d-beta3+ Author Needs SampleBoot 1.0.3 or later AlekseyMalykh/am-mod
■ ODDFORM 1.2.0 beta User report –
■ Rhythmer OS 0.2.0 User report Keep its Rhythmer and Samples folders at the card root jazzyrhythmer.github.io/mpc-sample
Using another system with SampleBoot? Tell us in an issue on GitHub or on r/mpcsample, with its name and version, and it goes on the list.
